items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: But Johnny Miller's New Orleans Frolicers

ctx.x: Oh...Dick...around...that...that happened around...that must have been around the twenties...the early twenties...

Well I know Johnny Miller made those records...I don't know if you heard them or not... But Johnny Miller's New Orleans Frolicers...I think he was playing for the Frolic when he made the record... Maybe so...uh...

Old man had a...had a powerful nice band out there...Sharky was in his prime...yeah...he could blow that off that home...he played a sweet home... For my money...he still does...he still plays nice home...
